observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a small, dark gray Lenovo desktop PC. The 'Lenovo' logo is embossed on the top. A blue Intel sticker is visible on the front edge. In the background, multiple identical units are stacked.

Photo 1: Side view of the same unit, showing ports: power, USB, audio jacks, and a blue USB 3.0 port. The 'ThinkCentre' logo is visible on the perforated side panel. A red stripe with 'Lenovo' runs vertically.
Photo 2: Another side view, similar to photo 1, showing the same ports and branding. The background shows more stacked units, some with visible labels and stickers.
All units appear to be in used condition, with some dust and minor scuffs. No visible damage or missing parts.

claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show the 'Lenovo' and 'ThinkCentre' branding, consistent with the ThinkCentre M900 Tiny model.
Photo 0 shows an Intel sticker, but it does not specify the processor model. No BIOS or system screen is shown to confirm the CPU.
No internal drive or system information is visible. The storage capacity cannot be confirmed from the photos.
No RAM modules or system information are visible. The RAM amount cannot be confirmed from the photos.

risks.risk: The CPU is not an Intel Core i5, or it is a lower-tier model.
risks.proof: A photo of the system BIOS screen or a screenshot from the Windows system info showing the exact CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has a lower-end or non-i5 CPU, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The storage is not 256GB SSD, or it is a slower HDD or smaller capacity.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal drive or a screenshot from the Windows Disk Management showing the drive size and type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has a smaller or slower drive, reducing value.

risks.risk: The RAM is not 8GB, or it is not functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the RAM modules inside the unit or a screenshot from the Windows system info showing the installed RAM.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it has less than 8GB or non-functional RAM, reducing value.

risks.risk: The unit is not working or has hidden hardware faults (e.g., power supply, motherboard).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit powering on, booting, and running a basic system check or Windows desktop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if it is non-functional or has faults, reducing value.

proof_requests: A photo or video of the system BIOS screen or Windows system info showing the exact CPU model.
A photo or video of the internal drive or Windows Disk Management showing the storage size and type.
A photo or video of the RAM modules or Windows system info showing the installed RAM.
A video clip showing the unit powering on and booting to the desktop.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as Lenovo ThinkCentre M900, but key specifications (CPU, RAM, storage) are unverified. Hidden risks include incorrect specs and non-functionality. Without proof of these, the item cannot be priced accurately.
